newsitem.title: USA: Burger King in Spielberg dinosaur tie-in.
newsitem.headline: Burger King in Spielberg dinosaur tie-in.

text.p: Burger King on Monday will begin selling dinosaur-decorated wristwatches as a promotional tie-in to "The Lost World: Jurassic Park", the sequel to Steven Spielberg's "Jurassic Park" movie due this summer, the company said on Friday.

"The Lost World" is being released by Universal Pictures, a unit of Seagram Co Ltd, and is widely expected to be popular since "Jurassic Park" and its tale of dinosaurs amok garnered box-office sales of more than $900 million.

Burger King, a leading fast-food group owned by Grand Metropolitan Plc of Britain, said in a news release it would also offer premiums for young children based on another Spielberg film, a cartoon with round-cheeked dinosaur characters called "The Land Before Time".
"'The Lost World' is PG-13 and we didn't think tie-ins from that would be appropriate" for younger children, a Burger King spokeswoman said.

The promotion will include watches selling for $1.99 with a specified food purchase and toys based on the cartoon film in packaged meals for young children. The promotion is to last six weeks, the company said.
